features.summary: Analyzers: the build's rules, the C# compiler's rung of D18.6 below the type stage and above the render. The analyzer package ships inside the core package on both lines and runs in every compilation that references it. Every analyzer of both lines carries its verdict in D18.6: ALIS001, ALIS004 and ALIS008 kept and retargeted to every block of Pipeline<TModel> in every file, ALIS002 kept as ALIS008 on an action's block, ALIS003 refused, ALIS005 kept, ALIS006 kept as an error, ALIS007 carried by ALIS030's single use, ALIS009 kept, and the slice tree's ALIS010 to ALIS013 kept for each project that carries a slice table. The rewrite adds the reflection analyzer (N18.1), the declaration analyzer (ALIS023, ALIS024), the override analyzer (ALIS025), the vendor contract analyzer (ALIS014 to ALIS022, ALIS037), the suppressors ALIS026, ALIS027 and ALIS036, and the families ALIS028 to ALIS035, ALIS038 and ALIS039. ALIS009's exemption is the redesign's public TypedDslExemptionAttribute, which an app's own component carries as Fusion's does, and no analyzer names a package built on the core. Main's exemption is internal and its ALIS009 checks only Fusion's and Native's Components namespaces; the redesign names Fusion, Native and NativeTagHelpers by assembly name and exempts a member whatever its reason says.

sentences.text: The core's build fails on a reflection call in a shipped package outside the owner's list, read as an operation, so new T() over a type parameter is an Activator read.
Every block of Pipeline<TModel>, an expression or a {} lambda in any file, keeps ALIS004's allowed statements and refuses the rest.
A request's constant URL, headers, statuses, busy targets and staged values are refused at build by ALIS030, and ShowValidationErrors outside a route by ALIS031.
A validator condition with no browser form outside WhenOnServer and UnlessOnServer is an error at build, ALIS006.

A NativeActionLink whose block's one request at its own level is no GET, whose route or query value is neither a C# value nor Row.Read(..) of its payload, or that sends Form, Inputs, Input or a header, is refused at build by ALIS035.
[TypedDslExemption("The vendor boundary: a library is described by the JavaScript names it uses.")] on a member of any package exempts it from ALIS009, and its reason is never empty.

meanings.meaning: No analyzer names a package built on the core. ALIS009 checks the whole public surface of a compilation that carries a slice table, the table ALIS013 reads, and a component declaration and a render helper in every compilation, shipped or brought; a member a type takes from an assembly that references no Alis.Reactive is the vendor's shape and outside it. A shipped package's table is held by the repo's architecture test, which names the packages, since a test is not the core. An exemption, TypedDslExemptionAttribute, exempts its member only with a reason that is not empty or white space.

A project's slice table is SliceTree.txt beside its project file, which a project built with AlisSliceTree on hands to the compiler as an additional file. Each line that holds an entry is a row, the first the foundation, and the entries of a row are parted by white space. An entry is a folder's path from the table's folder, written with /, and makes that one folder a slice; a dot is the files beside the table; Folder/* makes each folder directly under Folder a slice of its own, named by its path and holding every folder under it; a lone * does the same for the table's own folder. A file's slice is the slice of the folder it sits in. A file under bin or obj, or outside the table's folder, is in no slice, and none of the four rules reads it. The table has no other syntax.

ALIS010: a slice uses its own files and the rows before its own, and a use of a slice on a later row or on its own row is refused. A use is every type and member a file names that its own project declares: a base type, an interface, a constraint, an attribute and a type its arguments name, the type of a field, a property, an event, a parameter, a return or a local, a call, a creation, a member read or written, an operator or a conversion the project declares, the type of a cast, an as, a default or a new array, the operand of typeof, is, sizeof, nameof or a pattern, a lambda's or a local function's signature, and the type a using static or a using alias names, each with its type arguments, element types and pointed-at types. A type or member of another assembly is no use, and neither is a use the compiler adds and the file does not write, a base call among them; a conversion the project declares is a use wherever it converts. A constructor's call is a use of its type. The use is reported where it is written, and a declaration's at its name: "'{slice}' uses '{symbol}' of slice '{its slice}', a later row in SliceTree.txt: a slice uses only the rows before its own", with "its own row" for a slice of the same row.

ALIS011: a file's namespace is its project's root namespace, the assembly's name, and its first folder; a file beside the table is in the root namespace alone. Any other namespace is refused at the namespace's name, and types declared in no namespace at the first type's name: "'{file}' is in namespace '{found}'; a file's namespace is its project's root namespace and its first folder, '{expected}'". The redesign's rule, the root namespace for a file that declares a public type and the folder's for any other, leaves: a module is one namespace and one folder (the owner, 2026-11-06).

ALIS012: a public class that is neither sealed, abstract nor static, and that no type of its project derives from, is refused at its name: "'{class}' is public and nothing in the package derives from it; seal it".

ALIS013: a table that disagrees with its project is refused where the disagreement is, each message opening "SliceTree.txt and the package disagree: ". In the table, at the entry: "entry '{entry}' names no folder", "folder '{folder}' falls under '{slice}' and '{slice}'", "slice '{slice}' is in two rows". At a file's first token: "folder '{folder}' has no row". At a type's name: "'{type}' is declared in slices '{slice}' and '{slice}'", a type whose parts sit in two slices. With no location, at the compilation's end: "'{assembly}' is built with AlisSliceTree on and holds no SliceTree.txt", read from the AlisSliceTree build property, which the build hands the compiler, where the redesign named the shipped packages (M20.X1). A compilation that hands the compiler no table and has AlisSliceTree off is read by none of the four rules.

ALIS009: a door is a member an assembly outside its compilation can name, public, protected or protected internal, as is every type that holds it; an explicit implementation is none. The rule reads every door of a compilation that hands the compiler a slice table (M20.D1), a table with no row among them, in every file a developer writes, inside the table's folder or outside it; a file a generator writes is not read. A door names the type of every value: object, dynamic and System.Type are untyped, alone or as an array's element, a pointer's target, a function pointer's parameter or return, or a type argument at any depth, a delegate's, an expression's, a tuple's and a generic holder's among them. The types read are the return and each parameter of a method, an operator, a conversion and a delegate, each parameter of a constructor and an indexer, the type of a property, a field and an event, the type arguments of a type's base and of its interfaces, and each constraint of a type's or a method's type parameter. Refused at the parameter's or the type parameter's name, else at the door's name: "'{door}' is a public door and names '{untyped}': a door is typed; write the value's own type, a type parameter or a typed source". A parameter that is a string or an array of strings, and whose name holds one of sixteen words or its plural, is named for what a door types: action, collection, event, field, kind, member, method, op, owner, param, path, peer, property, selector, subscribe, unsubscribe. A name's words part where a letter meets a digit or an underscore, at a capital after a small letter and at the last capital of a run before a small letter, as .NET's CA1054 parts a name to find a URI in it, and are compared without case. A string the compiler fills, a CallerMemberName, CallerFilePath or CallerArgumentExpression parameter, is not read; the surface check of spec/tools/check.py leaves the first, the one the designed surface holds (F5). Refused at the parameter's name: "'{door}' takes the string '{parameter}', named for '{word}': a public door names a member, field, event, method or path by a typed lambda or a declaration, never by a string". The words hold every name of both lines' lists, which matched a whole name (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/TypedDsl/UntypedComponentApiAnalyzer.cs:32-36 at 623dd4a27, Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/TypedDsl/UntypedComponentApiAnalyzer.cs:25-31 at 65fdf118d), and param, the name of main's doors that key a request by a string (Alis.Reactive/PlanAuthoring/Requests/GatherBuilder.cs:185 at 623dd4a27). The rule reads the name: a string that names a member under another name passes the build, and the package's PublicAPI text is where it is read. A member that overrides or implements one declared in an assembly that is neither its own compilation's, Alis.Reactive nor one that references Alis.Reactive is not read (M20.D1), and neither is a member the compiler writes; a partial member is read where it is defined. An exemption (M20.N1) with a reason exempts its member and no other; one whose reason is empty, white space or null exempts nothing and is refused at its reason, on a door or not: "An exemption from ALIS009 says why; give TypedDslExemption its reason". An attribute of that name that is not the core's exempts nothing, and a compilation that references no core is read all the same. The receiver of a C# 14 extension block is not read, since Roslyn 4.14.0, the analyzers' floor (spec/REWRITE.md, section 2.7), hands no member that names it; each member inside the block is read. The rule's reach to a component declaration and a render helper in a compilation with no table (M20.D1) lands with the unit that lands their types, U7.

features.oracle: The C# compiler's analyzer and suppressor rung as Roslyn runs it in each compilation that references the analyzer package; the repo's analyzer tests (tests/Alis.Reactive.AnalyzerTests at 65fdf118d) and the POC's analyzer builds, whose planted diagnostics NOTES records per unit (13a to 13h, 16a, 17c); RS0030 over poc/BannedSymbols.txt for the namespace ban of D18.4; and the spec itself where the framework is the authority: D18.6's rungs and its verdict per analyzer.

defects.defect: A public method of an app's own component package that carries a slice table takes object and builds, since ALIS009 checks the whole surface only of the packages it names (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/AnalyzerHelpers.cs:13-19 at 65fdf118d), and main's only of Fusion's and Native's Components namespaces (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/TypedDsl/UntypedComponentApiAnalyzer.cs:87-93 at 623dd4a27): ALIS009 refuses it, keyed on the table, naming no package (M20.D1, M20.D7).

[TypedDslExemption("")], or one whose reason is white space, exempts its member, since ALIS009 reads only the attribute's name (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/TypedDsl/UntypedComponentApiAnalyzer.cs:124-133 at 65fdf118d): ALIS009 refuses the exemption, "An exemption from ALIS009 says why; give TypedDslExemption its reason", so every exemption is auditable by its text (M20.D1, M20.D7, M20.N1).

A file of one slice names a type of a slice on a later row, or of another slice on its own row, and the project builds, so the layers the table states are a drawing the code leaves behind. ALIS010 refuses the use where it is written (M20.D2, M20.D3), as the redesign's does (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/SliceTree/SliceTreeAnalyzer.cs:303-312 at 65fdf118d).

A file's namespace is another module's, or a module's file sits in a namespace of its own making, so the namespace no longer says which module a type belongs to. ALIS011 refuses it at the namespace's name (M20.D2, M20.D4); the redesign expects the root namespace of a file with a public type and the folder's of any other (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/SliceTree/SliceTreeAnalyzer.cs:190-198 at 65fdf118d), which leaves.

A public class that nothing derives from is left open, so an app derives from a type the framework never meant as a base and the next release breaks it. ALIS012 refuses the class at its name (M20.D5), as the redesign's does (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/SliceTree/SliceTreeAnalyzer.cs:236-240 at 65fdf118d).

The table and its project drift apart: a folder no row holds, an entry that names no folder, a folder under two slices, a slice on two rows, a type whose parts sit in two slices, or a project built with AlisSliceTree on that hands the compiler no table, so ALIS010 reads a table that is not the project's and passes what it cannot place. ALIS013 refuses each where it is (M20.D2, M20.D6), as the redesign's table reader finds the first three (Alis.Reactive.Analyzers/SliceTree/SliceTable.cs:21-48 at 65fdf118d).
